attributes.title: SOC 2 CC6 — Logical and Physical Access Controls | Compliance Dashboard
attributes.description: SOC 2 TSC CC6 dashboard header with sub-criterion mapping
attributes.visState:
{"title": "SOC 2 CC6 — Logical and Physical Access Controls | Compliance Dashboard", "type": "markdown", "aggs": [], "params": {"fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": true, "markdown": "## SOC 2 — CC6: Logical and Physical Access Controls

**Trust Services Criterion:** The entity restricts logical and physical access to information assets to authorized users through authentication, authorization, and access management controls.

| Sub-Criterion | Audit Focus | Wazuh Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **CC6.1** | Logical access security — infrastructure and architecture protect against unauthorized access | Authentication failure analysis, brute force detection, access pattern anomalies |
| **CC6.2** | User registration and authorization — credentials issued to verified, authorized individuals | Account provisioning audit trail |
| **CC6.3** | Access authorization, modification, and removal — timely and appropriate | Account lifecycle events, privilege escalation monitoring |
| **CC6.6** | External threat protection — boundary controls and threat mitigation | Source IP analysis, geographic access patterns |
| **CC6.8** | Prevention or detection of unauthorized or malicious software | Correlated with authentication anomalies |

**Data Source:** Wazuh authentication, account management, and privilege escalation events from `rule.groups` including `authentication_failed`, `authentication_success`, `adduser`, `account_changed`, `sudo`, and TSC-tagged rules.  
**Default Evidence Period:** Last 90 days (SOC 2 Type 2 examination window)"}}
